source: The current official Dao-AILab repository exposes ZXNAME0000XZ as a CuTeDSL implementation optimized for Hopper and Blackwell GPUs such as H100 and B200, with installation through the flash-attn-4 package.[8]
zh: 当前的官方 Dao-AILab 存储库将 ZXNAME0000XZ 公开为针对 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU（例如 H100 和 B200）进行优化的 CuTeDSL 实现，并通过 flash-attn-4 软件包进行安装。 [8]
